decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY removes the Big Block FAQ attribute and rewrites all Big-Block-dependent ticket, funding, delivery, allocation, and revenue-split copy.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures the new $5-per-mint allocation to the remaining Small Block pool; the other Small Block rules remain valid.
The existing same-message MODIFY limits applicable draws and scope contexts to Small Block while preserving the unchanged VRF selection behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes both obsolete Big Block ticket-issuance attributes while retaining the valid Small Block issuance rules.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes the obsolete Big Block ticket counter and leaves the Small Block counter unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the process content with Small-Block-only ticket and prize descriptions and removes the Big Block references.
The existing same-message MODIFY records the $5 founder share, $5 commission share already in state, $5 Small Block pool share, and Small-Block-only pool destination.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter visibility attribute from NFT metadata.
Removing Big Block tickets does not change the established $5 no-referral commission fallback to a random existing NFT holder.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the affected mission-page section with Small-Block-only prize-pool content.
The removal of Big Blocks does not alter automatic direct-wallet delivery for prizes from the remaining Small Block mechanism.
The Winners page, dashboard, and email notification channels remain valid and unchanged for Small Block winners.
